Price Related Questions

1. Do you offer discounts?

Bulk orders and loyal customers qualify for discounts  .

2. Do you offer refunds?

We are guided by refund policies.

Additional Services

1. Do you offer delivery services?

Yes however they are fees depending with distance.

2.Do you offer consultation ?

Yes, basic consultation is free of charge. Farm visits at an agreed amount.

Products

1.What if find an issue with my products?

You can return it and get a refund or new product.

2.What’s the shelf life of your products?

Shelf life varies 2-5 years depending on the product. Check on the packaging or get in touch with us.

Other Service Related Info

1. How can I become your distributor?

Please get in touch with us to discuss distribution terms.

2. Do you work on Sundays/Public holidays?

No we do not work on these days.

HUMUSON Complex

What is the composition?

Makroelements: organic NPK
organic carbon (humified carbon and water-soluble carbon)
rich with natural vitamins: contains carotene (provitamin A), B1 B2 B3 B5 B6 B12 E,
C, D, P)
organic acids: folic acid, humic acids fulvic acid
trace elements (Mn, Cu, B, Zn, I, Br, Mo, V, Cr, Be, Ni, Ag, Sn, Pb As, Ba, Sr, Ti)
amino acids (Glutamic acid, Glycine, Valine, Arginine, Aspartic acid, Alanine, Serine,
Leucine, Isoleucine, Phenylalanine, Tyrosine, Lysine, Methionine, Threonine, Cystine)
contains enzymes ( peroxidase, reductase, protease)
glycoprotein, glomalin
phytohormones (auxin and cytokinin)
contains humin

2.What does it do?

HUMUSON Complex fills the top layer of
soils with beneficial, natural elements which
raise the activity of microorganisms to
restore soil’s chemical and physical
properties. Both factors restore the soil’s
natural properties of reproducing its own
fertility. It improves
plant metabolism and increases
consumption of minerals along with root
system formation

3.What's the organic base?

HUMUSON Complex is a new generation
100% organic fertilizer based on
SAPROPEL – centuries-old bottom
sediments of freshwater lakes, which
were formed from dead aquatic
vegetation, remnants of living organisms,
plankton and soil humus.

4.How & when to apply

For increased efficiency, it’s best to apply
on the planting station through drenching
close to the plant stalk aiming the ground,
but it can also be applied as a foliar.
We recommend applying basal at the land
preparation and/or planting stage.
Grow + should be applied at 4-6 leaves
stage every 10-14 days till flowering.
Recommended 2-3 applications

5.Can it replace synthetic fertilizers

They are not meant to replace synthetic
fertilizers, but to compliment them and
increase the efficiency of the synthetic ones.
This will lead to a yield increase of not less
than 30%. The usage of synthetic fertilizers
can be reduced up to 50%
Unless a farmer wants to go the strictly
organic way, then it’s possible to use
HUMUSON Complex only

6.How does it work

The principle of the effect of the product is based
on the multiplication effect due to the
involvement of all the main chains of biological
bonds:

  1. the expansion of the nutrition elements in the
    upper soil layer;
  2. activation of the action of positive soil
    microorganisms and PGB bacteria;
  3. improvement of the plant’s transport system
    and bioavailability of nutrients.

7.Whats unique

Ecocert-certified which qualifies for
export produce to EU, GB, and USA
markets
Developed to improve soil’s fertility
A unique natural origin “cocktail” which
contains more than 40 elements
Rapid release of nutrients
Ability to last long in the soil’s rhizosphere
It can clean the soil of chemical deposits
from synthetic fertilizers

8.Some of the benefits

Reduces costs (at least 25%) and sharply increases efficiency (up to 80%) by
raising soil fertility and nutrient assimilation
Enhances quality, yield, and taste of the crop
Create an organic layer in contaminated soil which helps to maintain soil moisture
and restores or improves of soil fertility
Promotes root development and growth to enable the plant to reach the leached
nutrients
No transport costs

Ask A Questions

If you have any questions please contact us we will answer your questions via email as
quickly as possible.

Landscape Design And Planting Process

Before we start a project we follow a strict process to make the garden the best, let’s see how
we work.

1 Consultation

We will meet with you at your garden site to discuss what you want from your garden. We will assess the site, and discuss with you how and by whom your garden will be used in order to get a clear picture of your needs. We will show you examples of our work and drawings to give you a better understanding of the scope of our work and the design process. We can also provide references and locations of some of our completed work sites you can visit and get a feel for our work.

2 Landscape Design Proposal

After the consultation visit we will provide you a firm landscape design proposal for the design requirements of your garden and the services you would like us to provide. Zimbabwe’s economy is agro-based and it’s agricultural produce heavily depends on fertilisers for increased crop production. However, the agri-
culture industry has been heavily dominated by chemical fertilisers which weakened productivity of the soil, hence the need for organic fertilisers to restore the soil among other benefits. MKM fertilisers was birthed upon realising a gap in the inconsistency and inadequate supply
of organic fertilisers in Zimbabwe.

Benefits of Our fertilizers

  • Sharply reduces fertiliser cost
  • Improves yield, quality & soil fertility
  • Longer & more efficient moisture retention capacity
  • Ideal for ome gardebnd and landscaping
  • Promotes root development & growth
  • Boost output on commercial farms & greenhouses
  • No transport costs
